$comment: Held-out evaluation set schema (hardening round, machinery only — the owner supplies or approves every sentence). One JSON object per line (JSONL). Offsets are Unicode scalar indices into the `text` field (the engine's canonical space; the assist engine's pub type ScalarOffset). Labels are written BEFORE any checker run (LABELLING_PROTOCOL.md rule 1).
title: Held-out sentence

id.description: Stable sentence id, e.g. ho-0001. Never reused across versions of the set.

text.description: The sentence exactly as it should be fed to the checker. Trailing whitespace is significant and must match the source. Never include author-identifying content.

category.description: The class the sentence belongs to (same classes as the golden smoke set).

labels.description: The labelled errors in this sentence, written before any checker run. Empty for `clean` sentences.

start.description: Scalar offset of the first character of the error.

end.description: Scalar offset one past the last character of the error (inclusive overlap matching).

category.description: The engine category this error belongs to.

expected.description: What a correct checker should flag here (short human note, e.g. 'subject-verb agreement').

source.description: Where this sentence came from. Either 'owner' (written/approved by the owner) or a precise citation of a public dataset WITHOUT redistributing its text in the repo (the loader script fetches it locally).

license.description: License of the sentence text. 'owner' for owner-written sentences. For public sets: the exact license name + whether commercial use is permitted. Non-commercial-licensed sentences may be scored locally but NEVER committed.
